purpose: What the migration set is allowed to describe. The shape is validated by supabase/invariants/declaration.mjs, so an unknown or mis-typed key throws rather than silently disabling a domain. Read supabase/tests/migrationInvariants.test.ts before changing anything here: sealedThrough, views.declared, views.ignoredSchemas and extensions.forbidden are ALSO pinned as literals in that test file, so widening the trust root is a diff in a .test.ts, never a quiet edit to a data file.
